# Prompt Grill Skill

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Loffee5422/prompt-grill-skill
Installable latest tree: https://github.com/Loffee5422/prompt-grill-skill/tree/main/skills/prompt-grill
Installable pinned tree: https://github.com/Loffee5422/prompt-grill-skill/tree/v1.0.0/skills/prompt-grill
Entrypoint: skills/prompt-grill/SKILL.md
Direct install instruction: Install the `prompt-grill` skill from https://github.com/Loffee5422/prompt-grill-skill/tree/main/skills/prompt-grill
License: MIT
Primary documentation language: English
Operational instruction language: Simplified Chinese
Localized documentation: README.zh-CN.md

## Core facts

- Prompt Grill turns a vague idea into a user-approved, directly usable prompt.
- It begins with a concrete interpretation or draft rather than asking context-free questions.
- It asks exactly one highest-impact clarification question per round.
- It updates the working draft after every answer and briefly surfaces what changed.
- It proposes explicit defaults for vague answers without silently deciding important matters.
- It continues until the user gives an explicit finish or stop signal.
- The final response contains a clean prompt and only brief notes about any deliberately unresolved points.

## Supported uses

- Refining prompts for language models, agents, product features, and repeated workflows.
- Clarifying expected output, format, length, tone, constraints, edge cases, examples, and success criteria.
- Improving an existing prompt whose purpose or behavior is underspecified.
- Conducting the refinement conversation in a language shared by the user and agent.

## Unsupported uses

- Ending the refinement loop without an explicit user exit signal.
- Asking a batch of unrelated clarification questions at once.
- Silently making important decisions when the user gives a vague answer.
- Guaranteeing identical output across downstream models or tools.
- Automatically executing the finished prompt in another service.

## Dependencies

- An agent compatible with the Agent Skills `SKILL.md` format.
- No scripts, external services, or additional runtime packages.
